for(const C of [Temporal.PlainYearMonth,Temporal.PlainMonthDay]){let touched=false;try{C.prototype.equals.call({}, {get calendar(){touched=true;throw 1;}});throw 2;}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TypeError)||touched)throw 3;}}const log=[];const one={get calendar(){log.push("one");throw 42;}},two={get calendar(){log.push("two");throw 43;}};try{Temporal.PlainYearMonth.compare(one,two);throw 1;}catch(e){if(e!==42||log.join()!=="one")throw 2;}
